name: Kuroi Shoudou
source: A collection of three short stories: "The Worst Day" in which the protagonist assaults a woman at a video store, "Your Slave" in which they harass a servant, and "Red Mark" in which they tutor a student in an indecent fashion.
translation: 三个短篇小说集：《最糟糕的一天》，主人公在音像店袭击了一名妇女；《你的奴隶》，他们骚扰仆人；《红色马克》，他们以不雅的方式辅导学生。
